skills.name: Parry
skills.desc: The character can now Parry as a Reaction when targeted with a melee attack. When parrying, they make an attack (spending all resources needed to make that attack.) Regardless of the success of the attack, subtract the damage the attack would have dealt from the damage the character will take. If the character's attack would have dealt more damage, deal an amount of damage equal to double the difference between the character's attack damage and the damage the character would have taken.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Unkillable
skills.desc: When the character drops to 0 or negative HP, they can choose to continue moving for the duration of 5 Actions, even while making Death Saving Throws.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: History Buff
skills.desc: Choose one of three traits of an area's history when the character gets this skill: its political history, its ancient history, or its natural history. The character can simply ask for information about this category by invoking this Skill, and has advantage on Insight and History checks related to it.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Artistry
skills.desc: Using an Action, this character can choose to add either their Flair modifier or their Charisma modifier to the next check of another sapient creature by adding a touch of artistry to the check. The player must justify how exactly their artistry helps with the check for this to work. They cannot target the same creature more than once with this skill within a 6 second span.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Rituals
skills.desc: This character can choose to add their Knowledge modifier to Religion checks on top of their Magic and Religion modifiers.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Strongarm
skills.desc: The character has advantage on Athletics checks to grapple other creatures, pick them up, or shove them in a direction. Additionally, when an effect would move the character, they can reduce the amount they are moved by 15ft.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Aware
skills.desc: Add 2 to the character's passive Perception and add 2 to the character's passive Aura.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Moment of Truth
skills.desc: Once per Rest, the character can choose to automatically pass an Aura, Appraisal, Investigation, or Perception check before they roll.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Fast Hands
skills.desc: The character can choose to use an item as a Reaction when they or an ally makes a Saving Throw.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Startled
skills.desc: The character has a strong knee-jerk reaction to harm. After they take damage or make a save, they can Move up to half one of their movement speeds as a Reaction. If the damaging effect causes damage in multiple stages, they can take this reaction after the first stage of damage, rather than after the entire effect concludes. This skill can only be used once every 6 seconds.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Inspiration
skills.desc: Whenever the character spends a Short rest creating art or performing, they gain one Inspiration, with a maximum of three. They can later spend this inspiration in an act of Artistry to add half of their Flair modifier, rounded up, to a failed Persuasion, Invention or Flair check in an attempt to force it to pass.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Hidden Purpose
skills.desc: When the character succeeds a Invention check to make an improvised tool or weapon, it is good enough that users of said tool or weapon can gain the full bonuses of proficiency, as if the tool or weapon was a normal version.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Stratagem (Old)
skills.desc: The character can choose to give one other character advantage on their next check or roll to hit by taking one Action to suggest a strategy. This works like a held action and expires after 6 seconds or at the start of their next turn.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Expertise
skills.desc: Choose two Attributes. When the character makes checks of this attribute type, add 3 to that check.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Spidey Senses
skills.desc: With a fine-tuned aurasense, the character can detect changes in the aura around them quick enough to react faster to magic. For any save they make against magic that they are not in control over, they can add 1.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Menacing Presence
skills.desc: The character's aura projects densely, allowing them to add half of their Mag bonus to Intimidation checks when their aura is projected.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Jack of More Trades
skills.desc: The character gains the ability to apply Expertise to a third Attribute.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Closer Look
skills.desc: The character has a sharp eye for inspecting objects, and can learn more from checks to learn about an object's history.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Theologist
skills.desc: The character has more comprehensive knowledge of religious symbols, and will almost always recognize which symbol corresponds to which god.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Sigil of Power
skills.desc: The character carves a sigil into their aura, allowing some of their god's power to seep in in a controlled manner. This grants an effect within 10ft based on the god they call to.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Tendrils
skills.desc: As the god's will wraps its tendrils around the character's mind, they start to feel power flow into them when they obey. The character will restore 2d4 MP whenever they complete a task in their god's will.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Undefeatable
skills.desc: Due to unending willpower, this character will not lose TruHP when they fail death saving throws. They also have advantage on saves against effects that would cause them to lose TruHP, and regain one fifth (rounded up) of their HP when they become stable from passing death saves.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Aurascale
skills.desc: Due to a thick, impenetrable aura, the character is able to resist changes in the magic around them. For any save they make against magic that they are not in control over, they can add 4.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Light-Footed
skills.desc: The character's flightiness has served them well; when they Move, they can also take the Hide action as part of the same Action once per six seconds.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Connected
skills.desc: The character has a contact in the area that they can rely on for support. Depending on the contact, they may be able to freely offer money, intelligence, or even help the party directly.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Persistent
skills.desc: Each time this character attempts a Persuasion check on the same sapient creature, they gain +1 to their roll for each day they've attempted Persuasion checks on them in the past, to a maximum of 7.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Mental Pinboard
skills.desc: This character can make an Insight check on a creature to gain specific information from little details, such as pet hair on clothing or smudged lipstick.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Storyteller
skills.desc: An experienced teller of tall tales, the character can use movement, magic, and anything else at their disposal to better communicate a story. They can add half of their Flair proficiency, rounded down, to their Persuasion checks.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Seasoned
skills.desc: The character can choose a single expertise to become a Deep Expertise, which grants them a +5 instead of a +3.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Wary
skills.desc: The character's passive Perception and Aura are raised by 10, and they can take the Hide action as a Free action once per Short Rest.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Halo
skills.desc: The character has earned enough good will with their god that they have a halo visible only to other worshippers of that god, marking them as a faithful servant. Other worshippers of the god, and institutions with connections to them, will gravitate towards them and respect them.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Mark of Divinity
skills.desc: The character's connection to their god becomes direct. Their god is capable of connecting their minds directly, for a time, but as a result, the god's essence begins to seep into the character's body and mind, leaving them with a divine mark. Refer to the Divine Marks table to see which divine mark the character gets.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Local Deities
skills.desc: The character opens their soul to their environment, becoming better able to sense which god or spirit has the most influence over an area. With grace and patience, their calls to the gods are to whatever is nearest, changing the effect of their Sigil of Power based on where they are.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Five Swords
skills.desc: When the character makes an attack without using a tool, it only costs one Action and deals 2d6 Break damage. As well, they can add their Fisticuffs proficiency plus either their Dex or Str bonus to hit.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Creature
skills.desc: After spending a Rest in a natural environment, the character attunes to it, increasing their movement speeds by 5ft, or by 10ft when navigating hazardous Spaces. They can also add their Perception or Investigation proficiency to saves against local environmental effects (effects that are present in a Space or multiple Spaces, but not the entire environment.)
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Muscle Through
skills.desc: Aggressive in the face of threats, the character can force their way through guards and keep them open. If the character succeeds a melee attack, they lower the Defense of the creature that they attacked by 2 for the next 6 seconds.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Guardian
skills.desc: When the character is touching a creature, they can choose to take any damage that creature would.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Headlock
skills.desc: The character can add an extra 1d6 of damage of whatever type would otherwise be dealt when they cause damage to a creature that they are Grappling.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Wriggly Bastard
skills.desc: The character's Defense increases by 2.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Life Mimics Art
skills.desc: The character is a master at depicting form and movement in still objects, whether by clay or heaps of scrap. The character can create a sculpture so lively that it entices a spirit to inhabit it. This spirit sculpture then gains 1 Durability and becomes loyal to the character. This sculpture has a movement speed of 30ft (with a type based on its material and shape) and can communicate telepathically with the character via a shared artistic vision. This sculpture counts as an Object but has the Summon 1 Object Tag, with the spirit being the one taking objects through it.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Many-Faced
skills.desc: The character’s proficiency with self-decoration allows them to give themself the Unrecognizable Creature Tag and have advantage on Persuasion checks to convince others they belong in any space.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: ★Divine Spirit
skills.desc: The character has an unusual connection to one of this world's gods, whether through accident or worship. They see signs of their deity where others do not, and know how to bring out their influence. Choose a god; the character gains the Divine Spirit buff related to that god, as seen in the [[gods->Deities and Forces of Nature]] page.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Lie Detector
skills.desc: If the character notices they are being lied to with an Insight check, they home in on what specific information is wrong and get a hint about what the correct information is.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Calming Presence
skills.desc: The character's skill at talking others up or down allows them to use the Help action on others' Willpower checks, as well as gain a +3 to Persuasion checks against hostile characters.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Flashback
skills.desc: The character can make an Insight or Investigation check on any object they find to determine a bit of its recent history.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Silent but Deadly
skills.desc: Sharp senses make careful movements, and this character uses that to the fullest. If this character is Hidden from the target of one of their effects, they can choose to take another Action against them every 6 seconds in exchange for no longer being Hidden.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Martial Insight
skills.desc:
The character can make an Insight check as a Free Action once every 6 seconds to gain one of the following pieces of information:
- The target's weak points (+4 to hit or -4 to their save with next action that targets them.)
- The target's intentions (broadly, or clues about what they intend to do immediately.)
- The target's motivations (broadly, or clues about their strategy.)
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Adaptable
skills.desc: The character can choose to craft a tool of a type that they have proficiency with out of things they find in their immediate environment as an Action, given they can find reasonable materials and explain how they do it. They also gain a bonus Tool Proficiency, which they can change once per Long Rest.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Speedster
skills.desc: The character gains an additional reaction.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Buckling Branch
skills.desc: This technique attacks the support of the target, such as the legs; on a hit, they must succeed an Acrobatics save against the character's Martial Arts DC or gain Stun I.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Capturing the Storm
skills.desc: Using this technique, the character subverts an opponent's armed strike to make them lose their grip on their weapon. On a hit, the target must succeed a Handiwork check against the character's Martial Arts DC or have their weapon taken by the character. They must beat the character in a Handiwork clash to get it back.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Spiraling Twig
skills.desc: While Grappled, this technique allows the character to escape the Grappled condition on a hit against the grappler.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Delayed Sword
skills.desc: The character cannot be targeted with opportunity attacks during the same round that they have used a Technique. The Delayed Sword technique can be used in the next Action or Reaction that the character takes after taking damage, and increases the damage of their unarmed attack to 3d6.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.desc: When the character takes damage, they can choose to reduce that damage by 2d6 once per 6 seconds.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Black and Blue
skills.desc: If the character chooses to make an attack without a weapon, this attack deals 3d6 Break damage. On a hit, they can choose to move the object or creature 5ft back.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Specialist
skills.desc: The character gains Expertise in three Tools of their choice.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Focused
skills.desc: The last creature that the character did a check on is the one that they are Focused on. They can consider their Def to be 10 higher if their attacker is the creature they are focused on.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Battle Tactics
skills.desc: The character can instruct one or more teammates on battle tactics to better get out of a risky situation. Choose two Stratagems from the Stratagems list that are unlocked by this Skill that the character is now able to use.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Sigil of Power II
skills.desc: The sigil in the character's aura grows in influence, and they gain the second buff on their God Power list for their god.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Weak Point
skills.desc:
When a creature has a Creature Tag that hinders it, the character can exploit that weakness. When making a check against a creature that has a tag that is not inherent to it (has been externally applied fairly recently), apply one of the following bonuses:
  • Gain +2 to a Persuasion check (if Charmed)
  • Gain +4 on checks made to attack the creature (if a sensory tag, such as Blinded, or a disorienting tag, such as Dizzy)
  • Gain 4 Def when next to a creature with any other tag.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Battle Stance
skills.desc: With an Action, the character can choose to enter a Battle Stance. While in the Battle Stance, all damage they take is reduced by 1d6. The battle stance drops when the character drops below half health.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Brutal Strike
skills.desc: Melee attacks deal an additional 2d6 damage when the character is in their Battle Stance. As well, Weaponless attacks deal 2d6 Break damage instead of 1d6.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Rise Again
skills.desc: When the character would become Unstable, they instead gain Stun 3 and return to max HP. They also don’t lose TruHP from this. They cannot use this Skill again until they have completed a Rest.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Tinkerer
skills.desc:
The character can spend a Rest modifying a tool to have a new use. They can give it one of the following object tags:
  • Specialized 1 (Type), where the Type depends on the material used to augment the tool: nightmare creatures (moonstone), aquatic or icy creatures (heatstone), fiery creatures (damprock.)
  • Shield 3
  • Grabbing 1
A given tool can only have one object tag from this Skill at a time.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Dubious Medical Practice
skills.desc: With a medicine check and some time, the character can choose to give a creature one of the following creature tags: Blinded 2 for 4 hours (requires 20 minutes), Frightened 1 for 1 hour (requires 30 seconds), Paralyzed 1 for 24 hours (requires 1 hour), Healthy 1 for 12 hours (requires 1 hour), or Unrecognizable permanently (only unrecognizable relative to old appearance, and new appearance will be recognizable as itself; requires 30 minutes. Can only be done once per creature.)
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Kill Combo
skills.desc: The character gains one additional reaction that they can take in response to succeeding a check against a creature. With this reaction, they can make another check against a creature (such as Attacking it,) Move, or Evade.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Weaponology
skills.desc: Trained in a wide variety of weapons, the character has a good intuition for using them. When using a weapon, treat it as if the character has 1 more proficiency point in it than they actually have. Any brand-new weapons start with one proficiency point already. As well, they can learn 1 of the Stratagems unlocked by this skill and use it in combat.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Arborist
skills.desc: Attuned highly to their surroundings, the character can sense the way magic flows through the wildlife around them. They can pick up on how the nature around them is doing, and why. If they focus for a few minutes, they can crudely communicate with a plant or wild animal with their aura.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Body and Spirit
skills.desc: The character has begun to blend their physicality with their spirituality. Opening their soul to the realm of gods, they are able to bolster their body and mind with the world's energies. They learn one technique from the Stratagems List unlocked by this skill, they automatically pass Willpower checks and saves, and they only have to sleep for 4 hours to get a Rest.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Divine Power
skills.desc: Calling upon the power of their god, the character unleashes a burst of magic that isn't theirs, usually an area effect, and then enters their Battle Stance. Check the Divine Spirit page to see what the burst of magic does.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Rewoven
skills.desc: The character's soul begins to fray, rips filling with the power of their god and weaving a stronger fabric. It becomes instantly obvious that their soul has been pulled apart in this way, and the character gains the major Mark of their God, along with whatever physical changes that brings.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Embracing the Medium
skills.desc: Combining their magical talents with their performing ones, the character is able to use touch-range magical abilities on creatures up to 45ft away that they can sense with their primary sense if they succeed on a Persuasion clash against their Insight.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Animal Tactics
skills.desc: The character knows the strengths, weaknesses, and motivations of their animal companions very well. Having trained them expertly, the character can assign Stratagems to any animal that they command in order to give them more actions and strategies. Choose 3 Stratagems from the Stratagems List that are unlocked by this Skill that the character is now able to use.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Group Focus
skills.desc: The character can choose one creature in a space adjacent to them to also gain the bonus from the Weak Point skill. If both beneficiaries take the same action against the target, the second one to do so gets advantage on their check.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Confidence Boost
skills.desc: Guided by empathy, the character's words are able to bolster another creature, giving them +3 to one of their statistics as they feel more sure of themself. This extra confidence lasts for an hour, and can only affect one creature at a time; in Adrenaline, the character is able to switch which creature is affected once per turn to any creature they can talk to.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Wearable Technology
skills.desc:
Sometimes, doohickeys can be so form-fitting that they become part of a person. This character can spend two Rests creating a device that is either form-fitting or literally built into themself or a willing creature. They can consider one limb or eye of the creature the device is made for to be an Object and able to take on Object Tags, such as from Borro abilities or the Tinkerer skill.
This new object can start with one of the following Object Tags:
  • - Shield 2. Gives the creature +2 to their Def.
  • - Bolstered Strike 1. This device can add 1d6 damage to an unarmed strike done by the limb of the creature that it augments.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: WT Prereq (placeholder)
skills.desc: Skill that precedes wearable technology
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Gremlin Fighter
skills.desc:
During a Rest, the character can give their spirit scupture up to 2 of the following Object Tags:
  • Solid 2
  • Sharp 5 (Break, Slice, or Pierce)
  • Glowing 1
  • Pretty 1
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Holy Weapon
skills.desc:
A weapon or tool so attuned that it is an extension of the self becomes a conduit for the otherworldly powers of the character's god. Choose one of the following object tags; the god's power manifests in the weapon or tool in this way.
  • Returning 80
  • Glowing 1
  • Sharp 1d6 (Type), where the damage type is most reasonable for the god
  • Damage 2 (Type), where the damage type is most reasonable for the god
  • Boost 2 (3 Proficiencies), where the 3 proficiencies are most reasonable for the god

These object tags can be considered to have been "cast" by their respective god, and as such are considered to only be dispelled in places where the god is completely prevented from having influence. If the character wants to attune a new weapon or tool to their god, they can do so over the course of a Respite; they can only have one item attuned at a time.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Holy Weapon II
skills.desc:
The weapon's attunement increases and becomes more abstract. It now has either 2 of the object tags from {80}, or 1 of the following tags, replacing the old tag:
  • Sharp 2d6, where the damage type is most reasonable for the god
  • Damage 4, where the damage type is most reasonable for the god
  • Luminous 1
The character can also change which object or tool is attuned to their god in the span of a Break.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Frenzy
skills.desc: When the character deals 6 or more damage with melee attacks in a turn while in their Battle Stance, they regain 1d6 HP.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Living Armor
skills.desc: When the character is in their battle stance, up to 2 creatures of their choice within 5ft of them take 1d6 less damage if the type is of Break, Slice, or Pierce.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Sharpshot
skills.desc: If the character rolls a 9 or lower on a check made to shoot a ranged weapon, that raw roll is considered a 10. Additionally, damage dealt from 40ft away or further deal extra Pierce damage equal to twice the number of talent skills the character has.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Divine Justice
skills.desc: The character gains the ability to use a holy weapon, as detailed in {80}. They also gain a Battle Stance, as detailed in {61}. They do not actually gain either of these skills; only their effects.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Limber
skills.desc: The character cannot gain the Paralyzed, Fallen or Slowed tags.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Monster Harvest
skills.desc:
After killing a creature with a statblock, hunting several game animals, or foraging for a Rest, the character can reap a material from the following list if the source would be able to provide it:
  • Warming Fur: a material that can be used to craft clothing and armor that is more resistant to extreme cold.
  • Aura Glands: a richly healthy material that can be infused with aura and used to remove negative Creature Tags, such as Plagued or Paralyzed.
  • Fangs: a material that can be affixed to a melee weapon or physical ammunition to increase its damage by 2 per strike.
  • Venom: poison that can be applied to a melee weapon or physical ammunition, such that they give their targets Plagued 2/0 (Toxin.)
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Ambusher
skills.desc: The character gains a +4 bonus to Stealth checks, or +10 in a natural environment they are attuned to. While hidden, they have advantage on saves.
skills.author: ClariseTG

skills.name: Nature Calls
skills.desc:
Nature itself has influence over the soul of the character, and they gain one of the following Creature Tags based on what they will need for their environment:
  • Super-Senses
  • Fluff
  • Respiration 16

It takes one Rest for this effect to change.
skills.author: ClariseTG
